## TL;DR
The latest review still blocks sign-off because signed-in Projects and Tasks have not been verified on this build. The human follow-up #1174 remains open with no results. This report records the current state accurately; no QA evidence has changed since review pass 6.

## Work and rationale
The QA record already identifies the missing signed-in verification and says the acceptance criterion remains open until #1174 records results. The review finding is therefore an evidence gap that cannot be truthfully closed from this worktree. I checked the current task state, the latest review, and #1174 before preparing this handoff report.

## Approaches tried
Earlier automated email-code entry did not reach the signed-in web UI. The required human follow-up asks a human to use normal email-code sign-in against this build, inspect Projects and Tasks, and record OS/build/results. #1174 remains human-assigned and has no result, so I did not infer a pass from the sign-in page or from another build.

## Challenges and blockers
The acceptance criterion remains unmet pending the human observation tracked by #1174. The current review also reported that it could not confirm mergeability because `git merge-tree --write-tree main HEAD` could not create a temporary file. No code or QA evidence has been changed in this turn.

## Key learnings
A clear pending note does not satisfy an acceptance criterion that explicitly requires signed-in Projects and Tasks to be observed on this build. Once #1174 records the result, the QA record can be updated from that evidence and the task can be reviewed again.
